name: quick-translate
description: Select text in any file and get a Google Translate popup right in the editor.

commands.title: Translate: Set Google Cloud API Key
Translate: Clear Google Cloud API Key

quickTranslate.targetLanguage.description: Target language code (e.g. vi, en, ja, zh-CN).

quickTranslate.sourceLanguage.description: Source language code, or 'auto' to detect.

quickTranslate.quickLanguages.description: Language codes shown as one-click shortcuts inside the popup. Set to [] to hide the row.

enumDescriptions: The hover popup, as before. The panel still records every translation; it just is not brought up.
The Translations panel only. No hover popup is opened, so nothing else can draw in it — the way to keep GitLens' commit card out of a translation for good.
Open the popup and bring the panel up behind it.
quickTranslate.showResultIn.markdownDescription: Where an answered request is shown. Every translation is recorded in the **Translations** panel whichever this is set to — the setting only decides what is brought up. `panel` is the one option that leaves the hover widget entirely: a hover is shared with every other extension answering that position, a webview is not.

enumDescriptions: The Secondary Side Bar on the right, where Claude Code and Copilot Chat sit.
The activity bar on the left, alongside Explorer and Source Control.
quickTranslate.panelLocation.markdownDescription: Which side bar the Translations panel is contributed to. A container is placed by where it is declared, so changing this swaps one declaration for the other — **reload the window** for it to take. Editors older than the Secondary Side Bar contribution point (some VS Code forks) show nothing on `secondary`; use `activitybar` there. Either way the view can be dragged between the two afterwards and the workbench remembers where you put it.

quickTranslate.historySize.description: How many translations the panel keeps. The oldest are dropped once the transcript passes this.

enumDescriptions: Rest the pointer on the marker (or on the selection) to open the popup.
Open the popup only when the marker is clicked. Nothing opens on hover, so hoverOnWord and autoShowPopup do nothing in this mode.

quickTranslate.showIconOnSelect.description: Show a small translate icon next to the selected text.

enumDescriptions: After the selection, except where that would put the icon in the end-of-line strip shared with GitLens, Error Lens and inline suggestions — there it goes in front instead.
Always after the last selected character.
Always in front of the first selected character.
quickTranslate.iconPosition.markdownDescription: Which side of the selection the 🌐 marker hangs off. An icon placed *after* a selection that ends at end of line is drawn in the strip past the last character, which GitLens blame, Error Lens and inline suggestions also write into — the marker then lands behind them, far to the right or off screen. `auto` puts it in front of the selection for exactly those lines.

enumDescriptions: At the end of the selection, except where that end is the end of the line — there the popup opens at the front instead, so GitLens' blame card does not open on top of it.
Always at the end of the selection. On a selection that runs to end of line this shares the popup with GitLens' blame card, which is drawn above the translation.
Always at the front of the selection.
quickTranslate.popupPosition.markdownDescription: Which end of the selection the translation popup opens at. VS Code gives every extension answering one position the same popup, and the column past the last character of a line is where GitLens answers with its commit card — so a popup asked for at the end of a full-line selection opens with that card above the translation. `auto` opens at the front for exactly those selections; set `end` to keep the popup at the end and live with the card, or turn `#gitlens.hovers.currentLine.enabled#` off.

quickTranslate.manualSelectionOnly.description: Only show the 🌐 marker for selections made with the mouse or the keyboard. Selections a command produced — stepping through Find matches, Select All, Expand Selection — leave no marker. The Translate Selection command and its keybinding still work on any selection.

quickTranslate.confirmBeforeTranslate.description: Require a click on the 🌐 marker before a selection is sent to the translation engine. Hovering the selection alone never triggers a request. Turn this off to translate on hover, as earlier versions did.

quickTranslate.autoShowPopup.description: Automatically open the translation popup as soon as text is selected (no hover needed).

quickTranslate.autoShowDelay.description: Delay in ms before reacting to a selection change.

quickTranslate.dragSettleDelay.description: Delay in ms before reacting once a mouse drag stops. The icon stays hidden while the selection is being dragged out, so this is roughly how long after releasing the mouse it appears.

quickTranslate.spinnerAfterDelay.description: Head start in ms a request gets before a spinner popup is opened for it. At 0 every request gets one. A request that finishes first opens a single popup with the translation, which avoids the spinner being replaced a moment later. Set to 0 to always show the spinner, or to a large number to never show it — the hourglass marker and the status bar report progress either way.

quickTranslate.hoverOnWord.description: Also translate the word under the cursor when nothing is selected.

quickTranslate.maxLength.markdownDescription: Maximum number of characters sent to the translation engine. The free endpoint carries the text in the URL and rejects anything past roughly 16 KB, which a CJK character reaches after about 1,800 characters — raise this only with `#quickTranslate.apiKey#` set.

enumDescriptions: Keep every line break: each line is translated and shown on its own line.
Only keep blank lines between paragraphs; hard-wrapped lines are folded into one sentence.
Flatten the whole selection onto a single line.
quickTranslate.preserveLineBreaks.description: How line breaks in the selected text are handled.

quickTranslate.renderMarkdown.markdownDescription: Render Markdown tables in the popup as tables. Only blocks that Markdown would accept as a table — consecutive `|` rows carrying a `| --- |` divider — are treated this way; every other line keeps its own line break as before.

quickTranslate.stripCommentMarkers.description: Strip //, /*, *, # and leading indentation from the selected text before translating.

quickTranslate.showStatusBar.description: Show the current language pair in the status bar.

quickTranslate.apiKey.markdownDeprecationMessage: Superseded by the **Translate: Set Google Cloud API Key** command, which keeps the key in the OS keychain instead of settings.json. A value left here is moved into the keychain on the next start and then removed.
quickTranslate.apiKey.markdownDescription: Deprecated — run **Translate: Set Google Cloud API Key** instead. With no key the free, unofficial endpoints are used (`clients5.google.com`, falling back to `translate.googleapis.com`); with one, the official Cloud Translation API v2 handles every request and the free endpoints are never called.

quickTranslate.proxy.description: Optional host to use instead of clients5.google.com (e.g. a mirror).
